shared_elements: repeated identical motifs in a row
justification: The only real correspondence is formal and generic: both surfaces organise repeated motifs in roughly horizontal rows or bands, and both use outline-drawn forms without shading. In content they are entirely different — A shows figurative narrative imagery (crewed boats with rows of stroke-like crew marks, human figures, a ladder-like sign) while B shows purely ornamental vegetal and geometric registers (rosettes, palmette/leaf scrolls, an arcaded lower frieze), with no figures, boats or animals at all.
